answer: The thread of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Each submission hangs on the willow of a task receipt, and the cipher is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
